mixed_string_G3_boundary.protocol: Native G3 on G string minus mean Fsharp3 on D and Gsharp3 on G, representing the normal switch at the openG string. This intentionally includes differing physical strings; it is not the same-string resonance metric.

late_upper_tail_coverage.scope: Each row aggregates all12 Classic constructions. Paired profile minus Before, before recalibration. Full signal and individual-partial statistics remain in the ignored full summary.

assessment_limits: Native peaks/frames/hashes and scalar-independent signal changes establish physical behavior, not a listener preference or realism.
The wound D string is exact Before by design; any banjo cue there is retained. G receives only+.1944 rather than+.30.

Late H8–H12/H1 values include independent peak tracking. Pooled per-note upper energy and broad2–6kHz/H1 checks accompany qualified individual-partial medians, so quiet partials do not determine the conclusion.
A higher late upper/H1 ratio can come from a weaker late fundamental even if absolute upper energy falls; both changes are reported.
Prototype precedes level-table recalibration. Passing a native note audit alone does not settle phrase-level targets or alternate-chord policy.
